og_title: Multiple Dogs? How to Keep Their Potty Logs Straight
main:
Raising Multiple Dogs? How to Keep Their Potty Logs Straight

Give each dog its own profile and log there. Then you'll never mix up whose poop or walk it was.

Common struggles in multi-dog households

  • When you walk them together, it's hard to remember which dog went.
  • One dog's log keeps growing while the other one gets missed.
  • Each family member looks after a different dog, so nobody knows how the other dogs are doing.

Tips to stay organized

  1. Log each dog in its own separate profile
  2. On walks, pick the dog that went right away and log it
  3. Switch between dogs at the top of the app as you log

POOPIEMATE multi-dog profiles

In POOPIEMATE, you can create a profile for each dog and share each one with family. Whether you have two dogs or three, just keep the profiles separate and you'll always know whose record it is.

FAQ

How do I keep records separate when I have several dogs?

Create a separate profile for each dog and log there. Then you'll always know whose poop or walk it was.

Can I share each dog's profile with different family members?

Yes. Set up a profile for each dog and share each one with whichever family members you like.
